title: The Flaming Flamingo Flap
crime_description: All 37 plastic lawn flamingos along Maple Street were dressed in hand-knitted turtleneck sweaters overnight.
setting: The Pristine Suburban Lawns of Whisper Pines

suspect.name: Zephyrine LaFleur 'The Fiber Fool'
suspect.quirk: Speaks in whimsical French pastry metaphors

dossier.text: Security camera footage shows a figure in a black hoodie entering Maple Street at 10:15 PM wearing gloves.
The hand-knitted turtleneck sweaters have a distinctive blue thread that matches the exact shade used in local craft store 'Yarns-R-Us'.
Eyewitness, Whisper Pines resident Agatha Pocket, reported hearing strange whirring noises coming from her kitchen window at 10:45 PM.

truth_timeline.event: Zephyrine LaFleur sneaks onto Maple Street, using her fiber art expertise to quickly knit sweaters.
Zephyrine rapidly dresses the flamingos in the hand-knitted sweaters.
Zephyrine flees, dropping a discarded ball of blue yarn near the scene.

lie_plan.cover_story: I was at home, preparing for a fiber art exhibition at the local museum.

weak_points.claim: I was actually working on my own fiber art installation, and it was the blue yarn that was accidentally dropped.
weak_points.planned_slip: Slip: 'Oh, I was probably just, uh, dropping off a sample yarn... for the museum.'

weak_points.claim: The blue thread is actually from my own stash, I must have accidentally brought it to the scene.
weak_points.planned_slip: Slip: 'Well, I could have sworn I used a different thread... maybe I mixed it up with my own supplies?'

weak_points.claim: The whirring noises were just my own machine, I was working on a new project.
weak_points.planned_slip: Slip: 'Oh, I'm sure it was just my own machine... I mean, I'm a professional, I know my equipment.'

solution_contradictions: Zephyrine claimed she was working on her own fiber art installation, which directly conflicts with fact-1.
Zephyrine claimed the blue thread was from her own stash, which directly conflicts with fact-2.
